description: This file defines a React functional component called TopNav, which renders a top navigation bar with branding and user action links (profile, login/logout). It imports React, React Router components, and a custom authentication context hook, and manages user sign-out and navigation.

methods.name: TopNav()
methods.description: React functional component rendering the top navigation bar, handling user login/logout display and actions.

methods.name: handleLogout
methods.description: Asynchronous function that calls signOut from auth context and navigates to login page upon success.
